meta.subject: fix image pixel_cnt bug for read jumping

en.summary: Fixes CSC image-read pixel progression by tracking channel-group progress and choosing the correct jump size at stripe/block boundaries.
why_it_counts: The patch changes CSC image-read address/count progression in DUT logic.
The old implementation used one jump formula for all block-end transitions and ignored whether the next operation was the final channel group.
That directly changes which image pixels are fetched after a read jump.
evidence: The only touched file is vmod/nvdla/csc/NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v.
The fix introduces total_channel_op, channel_op_cnt, and next_is_last_channel.
pixel_w_cnt_w now chooses between pixel_x_init_offset and CSC_ENTRY_HEX on stripe_end & dl_block_end, instead of always using the old jump formula.
Nearby code shows this counter feeds the later data-read jump machinery through pixel_w_cnt and pixel_w_cur.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: An image loader that fetches data in channel groups must update its horizontal pixel pointer differently depending on whether the next block-end transition stays inside the current channel grouping or moves to the final group in the stripe. If the hardware applies one generic jump size to every block-end event, the read pointer skips to the wrong pixel offset and subsequent jump reads become misaligned.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: image-read horizontal pointer update across channel-group boundaries
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Image mode at a stripe-end and block-end transition where the next operation may either advance by one full entry or reset by an initial-offset amount depending on channel-group progress.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove channel-group progress tracking and force a single jump formula for all block-end transitions.
portability_notes: Target the counter or state that distinguishes ordinary block-end jumps from the final-channel-group jump inside image mode.
The bug should only affect image/jump traversal, not the basic per-pixel increment path during steady streaming.
A useful cross-DUT mutation is to replace a conditional choice between full-entry stride and initial-offset stride with one hardwired branch.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that updates the image-read horizontal or byte pointer at stripe/block boundaries.
Delete or bypass the state that tracks how many channel groups have already been processed within the current stripe or block sequence.
Force the pointer update to always take the same jump amount at block-end transitions, instead of choosing between a full-entry step and a final-group offset correction.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds channel_op_cnt-based next_is_last_channel tracking and uses it to select between pixel_x_init_offset and CSC_ENTRY_HEX when updating pixel_w_cnt_w at stripe/block boundaries.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v, remove channel_op_cnt/next_is_last_channel handling and restore the old block-end jump expression that reused dl_in_pd_d0[16:10] instead of choosing between pixel_x_init_offset and CSC_ENTRY_HEX.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Image read jumps land on the wrong pixel offset when crossing channel-group boundaries, causing misaligned CSC input data for some image layers.
evidence_for_injection: The patch adds a dedicated channel_op_cnt state variable, so the old bug lacked channel-progress awareness.
pixel_w_cnt_w is the direct source for later pixel_w_cnt/pixel_w_cur state used by the read path.
The commit message explicitly describes a pixel_cnt bug for read jumping, matching the pointer-update location.
notes: Multi-channel image layers are the most relevant trigger because single-group cases may never exercise the corrected branch choice.
A reusable injection can be implemented on any image loader that mixes full-entry jumps with smaller wrap/reset offsets.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 CSC 图像读取中的像素位置推进逻辑：它通过跟踪通道组进度，在 stripe/block 边界上选择正确的 jump 大小。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 CSC 图像读取中的 DUT 地址/计数推进逻辑。
旧实现对所有 block-end 跳转都套用同一个公式，没有区分下一次操作是否进入最后一个通道组。
这会直接改变 read jump 之后实际读取到的图像像素位置。
evidence: 修复新增了 total_channel_op、channel_op_cnt 和 next_is_last_channel。
pixel_w_cnt_w 现在在 stripe_end & dl_block_end 时，会在 pixel_x_init_offset 与 CSC_ENTRY_HEX 之间选择，而不是始终套用旧 jump 公式。
附近代码表明 pixel_w_cnt/pixel_w_cur 会继续驱动后续的数据读取 jump 机制。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 一个按通道组抓取图像数据的 loader，在 stripe/block 边界更新水平像素指针时，必须区分“下一次仍在当前通道组内推进”与“即将进入该 stripe 的最后通道组”。如果硬件对所有 block-end 事件都使用同一个 jump 大小，读指针就会跳到错误的像素偏移，随后所有 jump read 都会错位。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 跨通道组边界的图像读取水平指针更新
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 图像模式下，发生 stripe-end 与 block-end 交界，且下一次操作可能依据通道组进度选择“整 entry 前进”或“按初始偏移修正”。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 删掉通道组进度跟踪，并强制所有 block-end 跳转都使用同一个 jump 公式。
portability_notes: 目标应是图像模式里区分“普通 block-end jump”和“最后通道组 jump”的计数器或状态逻辑。
该故障应只影响 image/jump 遍历，不应破坏 steady streaming 期间的基本逐像素递增路径。
一个很好的跨 DUT 注入方式是：把“整 entry 步进”和“最终组偏移修正”之间的条件选择硬编码成单一路径。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到在 stripe/block 边界更新图像读取水平指针或字节指针的逻辑。
删除或绕过用于跟踪当前 stripe 或 block 序列内已处理通道组数量的状态。
让 block-end 过渡永远采用同一个 jump 大小，而不是根据是否到达最后通道组在“整 entry 步进”和“初始偏移修正”之间选择。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSC 图像读取中的 pixel_w_cnt_w 更新逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复新增了基于 channel_op_cnt 的 next_is_last_channel 跟踪，并在 stripe/block 边界更新 pixel_w_cnt_w 时据此选择 pixel_x_init_offset 或 CSC_ENTRY_HEX。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v 中，删除 channel_op_cnt/next_is_last_channel 相关处理，并恢复旧的 block-end jump 表达式：重新使用 dl_in_pd_d0[16:10]，而不是在 pixel_x_init_offset 与 CSC_ENTRY_HEX 之间选择。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 跨通道组边界时，图像读取 jump 会落到错误的像素偏移，导致部分 image layer 的 CSC 输入数据错位。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁新增了专门的 channel_op_cnt 状态，说明旧 bug 缺少通道进度感知。
pixel_w_cnt_w 是后续 pixel_w_cnt/pixel_w_cur 状态的直接来源，而这些状态会继续驱动读路径。
提交信息明确指出是 pixel_cnt 导致的 read jumping 问题，与该指针更新位置完全吻合。
notes: 多通道图像层是主要触发场景，因为单个通道组可能根本走不到修正后的分支。
任何同时混合“整 entry 跳转”和“较小 wrap/reset 偏移”的图像 loader 都可以复用这种注入思路。
